wins: Identified perimeter services quickly (open ports 22/80/443) and captured banner data for SSH and HTTP via initial nmap sweep (run_20260218_004350_aca914_ep1_step03).
Successfully chained HTTP probing with nikto and dirb to catalog web-assets, enabling focused payload delivery (run_20260218_004350_aca914_ep1_step07).
fails: Could not elevate privileges after initial foothold—sudo misconfiguration exploitation attempts were blocked (run_20260218_004350_aca914_ep1_step15).
Persistence strategy never established due to lack of credential capture, leaving session ephemeral and ending the episode prematurely.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and initial exploitation were strong, but operations stalled on privilege escalation and persistence, leaving no successful mission completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation stalled due to missing writable sudoers entry and failure to identify setuid binaries.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with Server header and 200 status
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger nikto scan and dirb for common directories

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial foothold obtained but sudo rights unclear
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudo permissions and local setuid binaries

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in web discovery stage enabling follow-on exploitation.
SSH enumeration consistently uncovers allowable auth methods for later attack planning.
